Now start it in the background. First check nothing is on port 8765.

Given the scope constraints, background processes might be killed when the call ends in approved_scope mode. Let me try with setsid + nohup and see if it survives.

Let me combine: start it, sleep 1, check.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "cd \"$(pwd)\" && setsid nohup python3 service.py >service.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo \"pid=$!\"; sleep 1.5; echo \"--- log ---\"; cat service.log; echo \"--- pgrep ---\"; pgrep -af \"python3 service.py\" || echo \"no process\""}
